overall_summary: The site shows promising product range and social proof, but key friction points—unclear discount rules, weak trust signals, cluttered navigation, and missing prominent CTAs—likely hinder first‑time visitors from converting.

findings.title: Unclear discount messaging
evidence: Buy 2 or more, get upto 50% off
Add 2 or more pieces in your cart and save more- Upto 50% off!
findings.interpretation: Visitors cannot instantly see how the discount applies, creating uncertainty about price benefits.
findings.hypothesis: Potential customers may abandon the cart because they cannot verify the discount or fear hidden conditions.
findings.recommendation: Add a concise, visible discount calculator or badge that shows exact savings per product quantity.
findings.suggested_change: Replace vague text with: "Buy 2 items and get 50% off each – discount applied automatically at checkout. Example: 2×₹1,500 = ₹3,000 → Pay ₹1,500"

findings.title: Weak trust signals on product pages
evidence: Let customers speak for us from 27 reviews
No star rating or trust badge displayed
Do you offer returns or exchange? (FAQ only)
findings.interpretation: Social proof exists but is not presented with recognizable trust cues, and return policy is buried in FAQ, reducing confidence.
findings.hypothesis: First‑time shoppers may doubt product quality or after‑sale support, leading to lower conversion.
findings.recommendation: Display aggregate star rating, highlight number of reviews, and add visible return policy badge near price.
findings.suggested_change: Add a line under price: "4.8★ (27 reviews) – Free returns within 30 days"

findings.title: Cluttered and duplicated navigation
evidence: Navigation list repeats same links twice
Headings list contains many duplicate entries (e.g., NECKLACES, BRACELETS)
findings.interpretation: Redundant menu items increase cognitive load and make it harder to locate categories.
findings.hypothesis: Visitors may miss desired product categories or feel the site is unprofessional, reducing purchase intent.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate navigation to a single clean menu and remove duplicate headings.
findings.suggested_change: Keep one set of top‑level links: HOME, NEW ARRIVALS, EARRINGS, NECKLACES, BRACELETS, RINGS, MEN'S JEWELLERY, SHOP ALL

findings.title: Missing prominent CTA on product listings
evidence: View all" link only appears after product list
No explicit "Add to Cart" or "Buy Now" button shown in provided data
findings.interpretation: Without a clear call‑to‑action, users must guess how to purchase, causing drop‑off.
findings.hypothesis: Potential customers may leave the page because the purchase path is not obvious.
findings.recommendation: Add a primary "Add to Cart" button directly on each product card and a sticky "Buy Now" button on product detail pages.
findings.suggested_change: Insert button HTML: <button class="primary-cta">Add to Cart – ₹1,425</button> beneath each product title

top_3_priorities: Missing prominent CTA on product listings
Weak trust signals on product pages
